CodeIP.definition: Pinned repository check: compare decoded and target message prefixes using an available-message count derived from the configured generation length.
CodeIP.replay_mapping: Local indexed-survivor agreement accepts iff every surviving site matches its original indexed target; zero survivors are accepted vacuously. Interior erasures select indexed targets rather than the pinned repository check's contiguous prefix. Historical available_prefix output keys retain their names for compatibility and do not denote literal repository-prefix scores.
CodeIP.paper_method: Final paper §3.4 Eq.(6) selects the full candidate message with maximal token-evidence score; §4.3 reports successful message extraction. This is distinct from the pinned repository prefix check.

STONE.definition: The pinned STEM helper averages transformed correctness, detectability, and a relative-perplexity component named naturalness in that code. The final 2026 paper calls its third criterion imperceptibility.
STONE.replay_mapping: No numeric STEM score is produced because the required model-based perplexity inputs are absent. Human naturalness is a separate interpretation dimension of this study; source similarity or human ratings do not substitute for the missing component.

SWEET.definition: Compute AUROC from negative and watermarked z-score arrays and report TPR at FPR bounds of zero, one percent, and five percent.
SWEET.replay_mapping: Watermarked z scores come from observed match counts. Negative scores are the exact fair-bit binomial null pooled over the observed surviving-site distribution.

SrcMarker.definition: Report mean per-bit agreement and exact recovery of all payload bits.
SrcMarker.replay_mapping: Per-bit agreement divides matching sites by the declared 24-bit payload, so deleted sites count as incorrect. Exact recovery requires all 24 sites to survive and match.

scope: Public definitions and explicit local adaptations are distinguished above. External source code is not redistributed, and the full external watermark systems are not executed.
